{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索雾港账簿记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"陆萤凭传言相信密账早已烧毁；杜衡亲手藏过密账，知道北仓暗格的位置。杜衡按原藏匿位置检查北仓暗格，并准备向双签授权人交账。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-LQR2","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A266294c1-4942-4a65-9686-e9aaf1d6b824:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:266294c1-4942-4a65-9686-e9aaf1d6b824"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["陆萤凭传言相信密账早已烧毁；杜衡亲手藏过密账，知道北仓暗格的位置。杜衡按原藏匿位置检查北仓暗格，并准备向双签授权人交账。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"杜衡把密账藏在北仓第三层暗格，公开航单只记载普通麻袋，不记载密账位置。仓库规约写明：密账只有持双签授权的人可以取阅。仓门外悬着一盏灰纸灯。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-LQR2","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A5353bc33-64a7-4602-921d-12bf42c442fb:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:5353bc33-64a7-4602-921d-12bf42c442fb"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["杜衡把密账藏在北仓第三层暗格，公开航单只记载普通麻袋，不记载密账位置。仓库规约写明：密账只有持双签授权的人可以取阅。仓门外悬着一盏灰纸灯。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"桥头磨坊按面粉重量收费，磨石转过五十圈，与仓库授权和密账无关。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-LQR2","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ac4b73bda-4ba1-4748-baa9-91017370bbfa:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:c4b73bda-4ba1-4748-baa9-91017370bbfa"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["桥头磨坊按面粉重量收费，磨石转过五十圈，与仓库授权和密账无关。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"双签授权人从北仓暗格取出密账，追查目标推进；陆萤依据烧毁传言仍把此案登记为无物证。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:wor
